files.how: loader index: PhysioNet bigP3BCI 1.0.0 SHA256SUMS.txt, byte-identical at physionet.org/files and physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com; read by moabb.datasets.download.download_if_missing before the recordings; retrieved 2026-10-16

revisions.note: Added SHA256SUMS.txt: PhysioNet's checksum index of bigP3BCI 1.0.0 (https://physionet.org/files/bigp3bci/1.0.0/SHA256SUMS.txt), byte-identical to https://physionet-open.s3.amazonaws.com/bigp3bci/1.0.0/SHA256SUMS.txt, retrieved 2026-10-16. MOABB's Mainsah2025 loader reads it (download_if_missing) to list the recordings of StudyQ before fetching them; with the file at the root of sourcedata/ the loader takes it from this deposit (lookup by the URL's file name). Checked: 360 of 360 deposited files are in it under bigP3BCI-data/StudyQ/ with the same SHA-256. Subject-less entry: shared by every subject's load.

revisions.change: added 720 missing StudyQ EDF files from PhysioNet bigp3bci 1.0.0 (SHA-256 verified against SHA256SUMS.txt); the deposit held only 360 of the 1080 StudyQ EDFs, so the Mainsah2025_Q loader downloaded the rest upstream
